narrative.overview: The Yemen Future design system embodies an uncompromising standard of institutional banking trust, structural precision, and modern financial inclusion. Rooted in the official corporate identity, the visual environment communicates safety, permanence, and technological forward-momentum for individual citizens, retail merchants, and enterprise partners across Yemen.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Shadows Architecture: Pure structural depth achieved via delicate 1px dividers, tonal surfaces, and crisp contrast without any box-shadow.
Sovereign Color Anchor: Authoritative Navy Blue (#1a2754) grounding headlines and primary actions, paired with uplifting Clear Sky Cyan (#73a7c1) for badges and directional cues.
Arabic-First Typographic Harmony: Native RTL flow with high-clarity IBM Plex Sans Arabic, ensuring effortless reading across varying devices and screen densities.
Restrained & Authoritative Micro-Interactions: Smooth 200–300ms transitions for button hovers, tab triggers, and navigation states that feel responsive and solid.

rules.name: The Sovereign Anchor Rule
rules.body: Primary navy (#1a2754) is the undisputed visual anchor of the page. Cyan (#73a7c1) acts as a selective secondary highlight and must never compete with Navy for structural dominance.

rules.name: The Pristine Contrast Rule
rules.body: All text and essential graphical elements must maintain at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their respective backgrounds, strictly meeting WCAG AA requirements on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Single-Typeface Purity Rule
rules.body: Only IBM Plex Sans Arabic is permitted across all textual elements. No secondary or serif fonts may be introduced.

rules.name: The Zero Shadows Rule
rules.body: Never apply shadow, shadow-md, shadow-lg, or CSS box-shadow properties to any card, button, modal, or dropdown. Flat, crisp boundaries define the institutional aesthetic.

dos: Do use Tailwind logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start) for all RTL layouts.
Do construct depth exclusively with 1px borders (#e2e8f0), background tints (#f0f6fa, #f8fafc), and white cards.
Do anchor display headlines with text-brand-navy (#1a2754) and reserve cyan for secondary accents and focus indicators.
Do maintain IBM Plex Sans Arabic across all typographic components.
donts: Don't introduce any shadow-* utility or CSS box-shadow under any circumstance.
Don't use dark mode or dark-themed container surfaces for primary content sections.
Don't mix arbitrary, non-brand hex codes when predefined --color-brand-* tokens exist.
Don't use hardcoded LTR layout classes like ml-, mr-, pl-, pr-, left-, or right-.
